```{r, message=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)

library(VennDiagram)
futile.logger::flog.threshold(futile.logger::ERROR, name = "VennDiagramLogger")
library(grid)

data_storage_folder = "../../../../Data/Processed/ClonalCultures/DNAm"
```


```{r}
order_df <- function(d, column, decreasing = F) {return(d[order(d[[column]], decreasing = decreasing),])}
```

```{r}
all_hyper_cpg <- list()
all_hypo_cpg <- list()
```


# IM vs. Non-IM, only new (EPIC) samples

```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_annotated_Sesame.RData") )
im_nonim_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNonIM_592_594_avg"]]
im_nonim_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )

```


We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and raw pvalue < 0.001 as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp =im_nonim_results 

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hyper_cpg_592_594$gene_symbol = strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & P.Value < 0.001)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594

```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 


## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=5}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.6, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```


# IM and non-IM vs. healthy, only new (EPIC) samples


```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_annotated_Sesame.RData") )
im_nonim_healthy_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
im_nonim_healthy_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_healthy_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = im_nonim_healthy_results

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.5, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.5, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

# IM and non-IM vs. healthy, 450k + EPIC samples


```{r}
load(file.path(data_storage_folder, "all_results_betas_IM_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_and_EPIC_annotated_Sesame.RData") )
im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results <- all_results_betas_annotated[["IMvsNormalAntrum"]]
im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results$gene_symbol = strsplit(im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";") |> sapply(function(x) paste(sort(unique(x)), collapse=",") )
```

We use |log2FC| > 0.2 and FDR < 5% as thresholds to select hyper- and hypomethylated CpGs

```{r}
tmp = im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results

hyper_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC > 0.20 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hyper_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hyper_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

hypo_cpg_592_594 = subset(tmp, logFC < -0.2 & adj.P.Val < 0.05)
hypo_genes_592_594 = unique(unlist(strsplit(hypo_cpg_592_594$UCSC_RefGene_Name, ";")))

n = "IM_vs_nonIM_with_healthy_450k_and_EPIC"
all_hyper_cpg[[n]] <- hyper_cpg_592_594
all_hypo_cpg[[n]] <- hypo_cpg_592_594
```

We identified `r length(hyper_genes_592_594)` hypermethylated and `r length(hypo_genes_592_594)` hypomethylated genes. 

## Most frequently hypermethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hyper_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.5, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypermethylated genes")
```


## Most frequently hypomethylated genes (Top 50)

```{r, fig.width=5, fig.height=7}
par(mar=c(5,10,4,1))
with(subset(hypo_cpg_592_594, gene_symbol!="") |> order_df("logFC"), table(gene_symbol) |> sort(decreasing = F)) |> tail(50) |> barplot(las=2, cex.names=.5, horiz=T, main="Most frequently hypomethylated genes")
```

```{r, eval=FALSE, fig.height=5}
library(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kanno.ilmn12.hg19)
data(Locations)
i450k_cpgs <- rownames(Locations)

lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) table(x$Row.names %in% i450k_cpgs))

aa <- merge(im_nonim_results, im_nonim_healthy_results, by="Row.names")
aa1 <- subset(aa, adj.P.Val.y < 0.05 & abs(logFC.y)>0.2)
spearman_r <- cor(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, method="spearman", use="pairwise")
plot(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, pch=20, xlab="IM EPIC",ylab="EPIC_Healthy", sub=paste0("Spearman r=",spearman_r))
abline(h=0,v=0, lty=2)
abline(a=0, b=1, col="red")

aa <- merge(im_nonim_healthy_450k_EPIC_results, im_nonim_healthy_results, by="Row.names")
aa1 <- subset(aa, adj.P.Val.y < 0.05 & abs(logFC.y)>0.2)
spearman_r <- cor(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, method="spearman", use="pairwise")
plot(aa1$logFC.x, aa1$logFC.y, pch=20, xlab="450k_and_EPIC",ylab="EPIC_Healthy", sub=paste0("Spearman r=",spearman_r))
abline(h=0,v=0, lty=2)
abline(a=0, b=1, col="red")
```



# Export

Gene/Cpg lists defined above are save to file *Methylation_DM_lists_Sesame.Rdata*.

```{r}
save(all_hyper_cpg, all_hypo_cpg, file=file.path(data_storage_folder, "Methylation_DM_lists_Sesame.Rdata"), compress=T)
```

# Overlaps

## Hypermethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
x <- venn.diagram(lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) x$Row.names), filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```
## Hypermethylated genes

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()
x <- venn.diagram(lapply(all_hyper_cpg, function(x) unique(x$gene_symbol)), filename = NULL, disable.logging = T, euler.d=T, 
                  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "green", "darkorchid1"),
                  cat.cex = .7)
grid.draw(x)
```

## Intersecting hypermethylated genes

```{r}
intersect = c()
for (n in names(all_hyper_cpg)) {
  if(length(intersect) ==0) {
    intersect = all_hyper_cpg[[n]]
    next
  } else {
    intersect = subset(intersect, Row.names %in% all_hyper_cpg[[n]]$Row.names) 
  }
}

intersect$gene_symbol |> table()

```

## Hypomethylated CpGs

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=6}
grid.newpage()

```
